title: Yellowed Brown Kenyan Chicken Thigh Kebabs
description: A fatty and aerated Kenyan dish featuring chicken thighs, lardons-render, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the chicken thighs into 1 1/2 inch pieces and set aside.
Render the lardons in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the chicken and lardons onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
